catalog.description: Runbook to investigate DNS resolution issue in Kubernetes clusters
Runbook to troubleshoot upgrade issues in Azure Kubernetes Service clusters

ONLY use for alerts named exactly 'KubeSchedulerDown' or 'KubeControllerManagerDown' from kube-prometheus-stack. Detects false positives in managed Kubernetes clusters (EKS, GKE, AKS) where these control plane components cannot be scraped by Prometheus.
